'''2007 Yavin 4 Regionals Patrick Johnson DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Patrick Johnson]] at [[2007 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|Cor-D-nomoneynopartsnodeal.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Pat Johnson
* '''Deck name:''' Use 2 or Lose 2
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
